description: Round half-up instead of half-to-even, introducing systematic upward bias on ties
expected_violation: A half-cent tie rounds up (0.125 -> 0.13) instead of to the nearest even cent (0.125 -> 0.12)
violation_scenario: compute_sales_tax('2.50', '5.0') computes tax 0.125 and returns '0.13' instead of the banker's-rounding '0.12'.
rationale: Switching the quantize rounding mode to half-up is the smallest change that violates the mandated banker's rounding on tie fractions, which no catalogue mutation names.
